speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to determine the cause, have you had any abnormal Pap smears or pelvic exams in the past?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your age and the adnexal mass, is this mass located on the left or right side, and what are its approximate dimensions? REQUEST TEST: Transvaginal Ultrasound. REQUEST IMAGES.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Pelvic Ultrasound Findings indicate a left adnexal mass and a thickened endometrial stripe. Specific dimensions for the mass were not provided in the available test data.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Intermittent bleeding from the vagina. I also have No recent weight loss, No fever, No changes in bladder or bowel habits. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pyelonephritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: That diagnosis of Pyelonephritis is highly unlikely given your primary symptom is vaginal bleeding rather than flank pain or urinary symptoms; your previous doctor may have been mistaken. REQUEST TEST: Pelvic MRI with contrast. While we await those images, have you experienced any foul-smelling discharge or lower abdominal pain?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Pelvic MRI with contrast findings are not available in the provided data. However, based on the existing Biopsy results showing "Well-differentiated adenocarcinoma" and the Pelvic Ultrasound findings of a "thickened endometrial stripe" and "left adnexal mass," the clinical picture is consistent with endometrial cancer with potential adnexal involvement, rather than Pyelonephritis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Adenocarcinoma with suspected left adnexal involvement.
